Screen UI comparison — NebullaOne vs ERPNext, Odoo, Zoho, Oracle, SAP

How each NebullaOne screen is laid out compared with the same screen in five platforms, using their published UI guidelines and product documentation. Screenshots are from your HTML (1440 × 860).

24UI patterns compared
19NebullaOne has
3partly
2missing
15screens compared

Gaps found and closed

Closed in this round: status bar on every document, related-document buttons with counts, comments with @mention, paging, board and calendar layouts (buttons on the left of the toolbar), phone layout, always-visible search, paid bill Hold form hidden, PO Status as the 2nd column. Still partly: bulk actions on every list, attachments on every record, PO / bill print.

Screen by screen

Vendor Registry — list

On par
NebullaOne
Vendor, status, type, trades, tier, registration, compliance, score; star for preferred; tabs Vendors / Invitations; Register & Invite buttons.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
All five show suppliers as a list with a search bar and saved filters (ERPNext Supplier list, Odoo Vendors kanban/list, Zoho Vendors, Oracle Manage Suppliers, SAP Manage Business Partner). Odoo opens Vendors as kanban cards by default.
Suggested
  • Done: search box always visible.
  • Saved views removed at your request.

Filters panel

On par
NebullaOne
Right-side panel, one section per column, coloured chips, multi-select, Reset / Apply; slim "n filters applied · Edit · Clear" line.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Oracle Redwood is closest (smart filter chips + Filters panel). SAP uses a filter bar with "Adapt Filters". Odoo puts Filters / Group By / Favorites in one dropdown under the search bar. ERPNext uses a filter row plus sidebar counts. Zoho uses saved custom views with criteria.
Suggested
  • Add "Save as view" at the bottom of the panel (Odoo Favorites, SAP variants, Redwood saved searches).
  • Show the count of records next to each chip (ERPNext sidebar counts).

Vendor record

On par
NebullaOne
Drawer with header (name, status menu, tags), 7 tabs: Overview (with contacts & addresses), Status & flags, Documents, Bank, Qualification, Equipment (contractors), Approvals (with activity).
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
ERPNext and Odoo open a full-page form with tabs; Odoo adds smart buttons (POs, bills, on-time rate) and chatter. SAP Fiori uses an object page with header facts and an anchor bar. Zoho shows the vendor detail beside the list with Overview / Transactions / Statements.
Suggested
  • Add count buttons in the header: POs, bills, contracts, open balance (Odoo smart buttons / ERPNext connections).
  • Add a comments box with @mention on the record.

Vendor approval

On par
NebullaOne
Same vendor drawer opened on Approvals: stages with approve / reject / request changes, blockers listed.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Oracle and SAP Ariba route approvals through a worklist / notifications; Odoo and ERPNext approve on the document (status bar buttons / workflow actions); Zoho approves from the document with an approval banner.
Suggested
  • Approval Management already gives the worklist; keep the stepper visible at the top of the drawer.

RFQ & quote comparison

Ahead of ERPNext / Odoo / Zoho
NebullaOne
Invited vendors with invitation / quote status, comparison sheet (L1 highlighted), weighted scoring, Award by line, Print / PDF.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Odoo compares RFQ lines from a call for tenders; ERPNext has a supplier quotation comparison report; Oracle and SAP Ariba have dedicated negotiation / sourcing event screens with line-level award.
Suggested
  • None needed — the side-by-side sheet with L1 highlight is clearer than ERPNext's report.

Purchase Orders — list

On par
NebullaOne
PO no., vendor, items · project, source, value, received bar, delivery date, billing status, status.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Oracle Redwood's Manage Purchase Orders adds metric tiles (match holds, overdue, drafts) above the list; SAP list report puts KPIs and a filter bar on top; Odoo shows RFQs and POs in one list with status badges.
Suggested
  • Status and Billing columns fall off-screen at 1440 px — move Status next to PO no.
  • Add tiles like Redwood: overdue deliveries, awaiting approval, bills on hold.

Purchase order record

On par
NebullaOne
Header with status pills, tiles (value, accepted %, rejected, billed), lines ordered vs received vs billed, goods receipts, returns, bills, revisions; Receive goods / Unlock & amend.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Odoo shows a status bar (RFQ → RFQ Sent → Purchase Order) and smart buttons (Receipts, Vendor Bills). SAP shows document flow. ERPNext shows a dashboard of connected receipts and invoices. Oracle shows a PO page with schedules and holds.
Suggested
  • Add a status bar (Draft → Issued → Received → Billed → Closed) at the top.
  • Add Print / PDF for the PO.

Goods receipt form

Different
NebullaOne
Modal on the PO: date, inspection result, accepted / rejected per line, stores, inspection template parameters, transport details.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
ERPNext Purchase Receipt and Odoo Receipt are full documents with their own list; SAP posts goods receipts in its own app; Oracle uses a Receive Items page.
Suggested
  • Fine as a modal for site users; the receipts list was removed earlier at your request.

Bills — list

On par
NebullaOne
Select box, Bill no., vendor, vendor bill no., amount, balance, next due, match, status; Select payable for batch payment.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Zoho Bills and Odoo Vendor Bills list with status badges and payment state; SAP Manage Supplier Invoices; Oracle Manage Invoices with hold indicators.
Suggested
  • Show the hold reason in a column, as Oracle does for holds.

Bill record

Needs tidy
NebullaOne
Header with status, tiles (amount, notes, settled, balance), payment schedule, hold, credit / debit notes, payments.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Odoo shows a vendor bill with status bar (Draft → Posted) and "Paid" ribbon; Zoho shows the bill with a payment banner; Oracle shows holds and validation status; SAP shows invoice and payment blocks.
Suggested
  • On a paid bill, hide the Hold form and the "should be paid: No" text — show a "Paid" ribbon like Odoo / Zoho.
  • Add Print / PDF.

Contract record

Ahead
NebullaOne
Header, BOQ, guarantees, approvals, change orders, terms, closure checklist; actions Submit / Sign / Terminate / Raise change order.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Oracle complex-work PO shows pay items, progress schedule and retainage columns; SAP outline agreement object page; ERPNext / Odoo / Zoho have no works-contract screen.
Suggested
  • Add a progress strip: Approved → Signed → Active → Handover → DLP → Closed.

RA bill record

Ahead
NebullaOne
Bill abstract (prev / this / cumulative), deductions (retention, advance, TDS, cess, material), certification steps, payable link.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Oracle work confirmation shows contract sum, completed value and projected retainage; SAP service entry sheet shows lines and approval; the others have no equivalent.
Suggested
  • None needed.

Overview dashboard

On par
NebullaOne
Tiles, action centre, expiring items, charts, top vendors.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Odoo and ERPNext have separate dashboards; SAP uses overview pages with cards; Oracle uses landing pages with infolets.
Suggested
  • Let users pin tiles they care about (SAP / Oracle allow card personalisation).

Supplier portal

Ahead
NebullaOne
Tabs for RFQs, POs, work orders, RA claims, attendance, punch list, bills, price list, documents, queries, users.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
Zoho vendor portal: accept PO, upload invoices. ERPNext: RFQ, quotations, orders, invoices. Oracle Supplier Portal: orders, ASNs, invoices, negotiations, profile. SAP: Ariba Network.
Suggested
  • None needed — contractor-side tabs are beyond the others.

Procurement Settings

On par
NebullaOne
Tabs Rules / Gates & approvals / Masters / Templates; Stop / Warn / Off toggles.
ERPNext · Odoo · Zoho · Oracle · SAP
ERPNext Buying Settings (single page of checkboxes); Odoo Purchase settings (sections with toggles); Oracle and SAP use setup / configuration apps.
Suggested
  • None needed.
